notes.title: More fixes! (v105)
notes.content: It's me again, with one final minor patch for achievements - if you are missing a tricky one, this fix will make it easier getting it :)

notes.title: Achievement fixes (v104)
notes.content: Hello all! A new small patch for REPUNK is live - this time it contains minor fixes for some achievements that weren't triggering in certain conditions. Have fun!

notes.title: French support! (v103)
notes.content:
I cannot believe it's been one month since the last update!

This time it's a slightly bigger build - [b]REPUNK is now fully localized to French (thank you Nolan!).[/b]

As for every supported language, this build comes with unique books from Earth written in French - some are translation of English authors; others are native French masters (hello Verne!).

Oh, and I almost forgot: it takes now roughly twice as long to freeze to death during nights. This should greatly help with night excursions.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Quick fix (v102)
notes.content: This build addresses issues with certain keyboards - the ENTER key isn't detected by the game. Now you can also click or try the numpad ENTER key.
